title: 第17章 历尽心劫第18章 晕倒
content_zh:
如同地狱般的淬炼之地中，不到十名学员站在原地，苦苦支撑着。
所有人感受到的痛苦都是相同的，这几名学员也是一样，他们脸上痛苦万分，甚至双腿都在发抖，却没有迈出脚步离开。
这几名学员，大都穿的破破烂烂的，姜地寒见到这一幕，不由得冷笑说道，“虽然修炼一途，需要大量的人力财力来支持，但往往成为强者之人，都是穷人家的孩子。”
韩影闻言也是同意点了点头，说道，“吃过苦，才有动力去改变命运，也就肯付出更多。不过这也不是绝对，那里就有一个富贵人家的孩子。”
“嗯？是么？”姜地寒仔细看去，果然有一个气质尊贵人也站在沙子中没有动。从穿着来开，此子的确家中富贵，在心火灼烧之中，一直紧皱眉头，双拳攥紧，浑身都在发抖。可即便如此，此子也没有失去气度。
他不像其他那些穷苦人家的孩子一样，虽然坚持但也在呻吟哀嚎，面目狰狞抓心挠肝，而是安静站着，保持着自己的风度，一声不吭的硬抗。
“如此疼痛，却也能坚持不变，此子与那些装模作样的纨绔子弟不同，是个真君子。”姜地寒满意点点头，眼神中透出赞赏的目光，“富贵人家还能有这种坚守，前途无量。”
韩影看着这个风度翩翩的学生，想了想，说道，“此子名为卞清流，也在昨日里亮起五道光柱，所有新生中，只有他们两个达到五道光柱。”
姜地寒微微点头，专心看着淬体之地的情况。经过长达一分钟左右的挣扎，那些疯狂逃命的学员们终于逃了出来，一个个满头大汗坐在地上如同瘫痪了一样。他们庆幸着自己从苦海中逃出，却没看到姜地寒和韩影看他们的冷漠眼神。
又过了一分钟，高大山实在是忍不住，‘噗通’一下跪在地上。只见他脸上尽是汗水，在他心里，他很想再坚持一会，他本来也可以做到，但昨晚的伤根本没好，身体太弱根本坚持不住。
不远处的李东石几人也坚持不住了，几人忍不住大喊出声，见到高大山倒地，李东石咬牙走了过去，说道，“大山兄，咱一起出去吧！”
高大山眉头紧皱点了点头，手扶着地上的沙子，心中万分不甘，跟着李东石几人往外走去。
高大山等人走上台阶离开淬体之地后，韩影从口袋中拿出几粒药丸递给他们，说道，“吃下去，身体疼痛会减少一点，还能让你们淬炼后的身体和天元都更好。”
高大山几人有些发愣看着老师，看着老师手中的几粒紫色药丸，几个人眼睛一下子就红了。在那些逃亡上来的人嫉妒的眼光中，几个人连忙从老师手中拿过药丸，感恩道谢后才吃下去。
“就剩三个了。”姜地寒看着空空荡荡的淬体之地，淡淡说道。
韩影闻言马上转头看去，果然，在偌大的淬体之地中，有两拨人在距离很远的地方各自站着。一边是卞清流独自站立，另外一边是付雨和陆安。
卞清流此时已经是虚汗淋漓，身体在瑟瑟发抖，摇摇欲坠。而另外一边，付雨却如同没事人一样站在沙子里，这一点让姜地寒和韩影皱起眉头，感觉到极为意外。
付雨的确有些百无聊赖，站在沙子里的她本来想快点上去，但刚刚那些人冲上去的样子实在是太不忍直视，才一直待到现在。看着身旁的陆安，想了想，她也没停留，直接移步离开淬体之地。
当付雨经过韩影身旁的时候，韩影见到付雨那吹弹可破的肌肤时，觉得自己根本没有给她丹药的必要。
只不过，付雨虽强，可不代表陆安也能这么好命。他感受到的痛苦和别人一样，但不同的是，他年纪太小了。

“我记得，他只有十二岁？”姜地寒开口，沉闷说道，“十二岁的孩子，承受的痛苦恐怕比别人强一倍啊。”
韩影闻言眉头一凛，什么也没说，仔细看着淬体之地的两人。
只剩下最后两人，所有学员的视线都不约而同集中在这两人身上。此时，两人虽然只是在淬体之地内坚持，但在他人眼里，仿佛已经变成一场比赛一样。
谁能坚持到最后？
content_en:
In the hell-like tempering place, less than ten students stood there, struggling to support themselves.
Everyone felt the same pain, and these students were the same. Their faces were extremely painful, and their legs were even shaking, but they did not take a step to leave.
Most of these students were wearing rags. When Jiang Dihan saw this scene, he couldn't help but sneered and said, "Although cultivation requires a lot of human and financial resources to support, those who become strong are often children from poor families."
Hearing this, Han Ying nodded in agreement and said, "After experiencing hardship, you have the motivation to change your destiny, and you are willing to pay more. But this is not absolute, there is a child from a wealthy family."
"Huh? Really?" Jiang Dihan looked carefully, and sure enough, there was a man of noble temperament standing in the sand without moving. Judging from the clothes he wore, he was indeed from a wealthy family. He was frowning, clenching his fists, and trembling all the time as his heart was burning. But even so, the boy did not lose his magnanimity.
He was not like other children from poor families who persisted but also moaned and whined, with a ferocious face and scratched their hearts. Instead, he stood quietly, maintained his demeanor, and resisted without saying a word.
"It hurts so much, but he can still persevere. This boy is different from those pretentious playboys. He is a true gentleman." Jiang Dihan nodded with satisfaction, with admiration in his eyes. "A rich man can still have this kind of perseverance, and his future is bright."
Han Ying looked at this elegant student, thought for a moment, and said, "This boy's name is Bian Qingliu, and he also lit up five beams of light yesterday. Among all the freshmen, only two of them reached the five beams of light."
Jiang Dihan nodded slightly and watched the situation in the body quenching land intently. After a minute-long struggle, the students who were frantically running for their lives finally escaped. They were all sitting on the ground sweating profusely, as if they were paralyzed. They were glad that they had escaped from the sea of ​​suffering, but they did not see the indifferent eyes of Jiang Dihan and Han Ying looking at them.
After another minute, Gao Dashan couldn't bear it any longer and knelt on the ground with a thud. His face was covered with sweat. In his heart, he wanted to hold on for a while longer. He could have done it, but the injury last night had not healed at all, and his body was too weak to hold on.
Not far away, Li Dongshi and others couldn't hold on any longer. They couldn't help shouting. Seeing Gao Dashan fall to the ground, Li Dongshi gritted his teeth and walked over and said, "Brother Dashan, let's go out together!"
Gao Dashan frowned and nodded. He held his hands on the sand on the ground and followed Li Dongshi and others outside with great reluctance.
After Gao Dashan and others walked up the steps and left the body quenching place, Han Ying took out a few pills from his pocket and handed them to them, saying, "Take them, and the pain in your body will be reduced. It will also make your body and Tianyuan better after tempering."
The people in Gao Dashan looked at the teacher in a daze. Looking at the purple pills in the teacher's hand, their eyes suddenly turned red. In the jealous eyes of those who fled, several people quickly took the pills from the teacher's hand and took them after expressing gratitude.
"There are only three left." Jiang Dihan looked at the empty body quenching place and said calmly.
When Han Ying heard this, he immediately turned around to look. Sure enough, in the huge body quenching land, there were two groups of people standing far apart. On one side was Bian Qingliu standing alone, and on the other side were Fu Yu and Lu An.
Bian Qingliu was already dripping with sweat at this time, and his body was trembling and shaky. On the other side, Fu Yu stood in the sand as if nothing happened. This made Jiang Dihan and Han Ying frown, feeling extremely surprised.
Fu Yu was indeed a little bored. Standing in the sand, she originally wanted to go up quickly, but the way those people rushed up just now was too unbearable to look at, so she stayed there until now. Looking at Lu An next to her, she thought for a while, but she didn’t stop either., move directly away from the body quenching place.
When Fu Yu passed by Han Ying, when Han Ying saw Fu Yu's skin that could be broken by a bullet, he felt that there was no need to give her the elixir.
However, although Fu Yu is strong, it does not mean that Lu An can have such a good life. He felt the same pain as everyone else, but the difference was that he was too young.
"I remember that he was only twelve years old?" Jiang Dihan said solemnly, "A twelve-year-old child will probably endure twice as much pain as others."
Han Ying frowned when he heard this, but said nothing and looked carefully at the two people in the Body Tempering Land.
Only the last two people were left, and all the students' eyes were focused on these two people. At this time, although the two of them were just persisting in the body quenching land, in the eyes of others, it seemed that it had become a competition.
Who can persist to the end?
